offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums, mainly entry-level and first-time and move-up buyers. Homes are built on land it acquires through lot option and land purchase arrangements, using subcontractors. It also offers mortgage, title and insurance services through affiliated businesses.

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title services; homeowners insurance services

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, first move-up and active adult homebuyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: closings of newly built homes to buyers; service fees: mortgage origination, title and insurance fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: acquires land and lots, builds homes with subcontracted labor and materials, sells to homebuyers; financial intermediary: mortgage, title and insurance services for its homebuyers

geography_served.value: US national: Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, Southwest, Mountain West and Texas markets, including Florida, Georgia, Carolinas, Texas, Arizona, Colorado

specialization.value: related lines: homebuilding plus affiliated mortgage, title and insurance services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: on-community sales agents and model homes selling to buyers; online: website lead generation and virtual home shopping; agents / brokers: third-party real estate brokers bringing buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: zoning, land use, environmental and building codes, mortgage lending rules (CFPB, RESPA) for financing affiliates
